enMap.Tại bảng khảo sát đời sống sinh hoạt ngư: The consumer life survey, published by the Household Economic Research Institute of the Consumer Administration on the 21st, shows that among married households, the proportion of households receiving financial support from "Parents-in-law" has increased, exceeding the proportion of households receiving financial support from "Parents-in-law".
enMap.Viện nghiên cứu này cho rằng \"Sự hiện d: "The presence of parents-in-law, who can provide practical support such as child care, is becoming more important," the institute said.
enMap.Theo như kết quả khảo sát, tỷ lệ nhận hỗ: According to survey results, the rate of receiving financial support only from parents-in-law in 2008 was 10.4%, up from 6.1% in 1998.
enMap.Mặt khác, tỷ lệ nhận hỗ trợ chỉ từ bố mẹ: On the other hand, the rate of receiving support only from parents-in-law was 9.2%, down from 14.1% in 1998.
enMap.Tỷ lệ hộ gia đình nhận hỗ trợ của cả 2 b: The proportion of households receiving support from both parents increased from 2.8% to 5%.
enMap.Phần lớn là những hộ gia đình không nhận: The majority are households that do not receive financial assistance, accounting for 75.4% in 2008.
enMap.Các hộ gia đình chỉ nhận hỗ trợ từ bố mẹ: Households only receive support from parents-in-law, using the most to pay for children such as tuition, accounting for 60%.
enMap.Những hộ gia đình đang kết hôn, dần tăng: Households that are getting married, gradually increase their connection with their parents-in-law with children as the center.
enMap.Trường hợp những hộ gia đình chỉ nhận sự: In the case of households that only receive financial support from their husband's parents, they spend the most on living expenses, accounting for 50%.
enMap.Khoảng tiền hỗ trợ, bình quân các hộ nhậ: About the amount of support, the average of households receiving support only from the wife's parents is 31,000 yen/month, the average of households receiving support only from the husband's parents is 43,000 yen/month.
enMap.Cuộc điều tra được thực hiện vào tháng 1: The investigation was conducted in October 2008.
enMap.Điều tra liên quan đến hỗ trợ tài chính: The financial support survey surveyed 576 women between the ages of 25 and 35.
